look.summary_zh: 中性 · 压暗中灰 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 124.0/255（变化 -3.5 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 0.954。中灰红减蓝 -1.5 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #EDCAB9、#D49679、#914F37；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #E01E22、#04CC39、#29068F。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 124.0/255 (-3.5 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 0.954; mid-gray red minus blue -1.5 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #EDCAB9, #D49679, #914F37. Red/green/blue swatches: #E01E22, #04CC39, #29068F.
look.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
